source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 12. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: The qiblah, the mihrab, the minbar and mosque manners

learn.en: A masjid is where Muslims pray five times a day. The mu'adh-dhin calls the adhan from it.
learn.title: The masjid

learn.en: The mihrab, an arch in the front wall, shows the qiblah. Next to it is the minbar, the pulpit for the Friday sermon.
learn.title: Mihrab and minbar

learn.en: Al-Masjid al-Haram in Makkah holds the Ka'bah. Al-Masjid an-Nabawi in Madinah is the second most honoured mosque.
learn.title: Two great mosques

learn.en: Enter with your right foot and say the du'aa.
learn.title: Going in
learn.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
learn.tr: Bismi-llāh, waṣ-ṣalātu was-salāmu ʿalā rasūli-llāh. Allāhumma ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik

learn.en: Leave your shoes at the door, walk in quietly, hold the door for others, and pray two rak'ahs before sitting.
learn.title: Mosque manners

learn.en: After each prayer, say Subhan-Allah, Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar 33 times each.
learn.title: After the prayer

learn.en: Leave with your left foot and say the du'aa.
learn.title: Going out
learn.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
learn.tr: Bismi-llāh, waṣ-ṣalātu was-salāmu ʿalā rasūli-llāh. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min faḍlik

words.en: Entering: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me
Leaving: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty

words.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، الحَمْدُ لِلهِ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
words.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, Allah is the Greatest

quiz.en: The mihrab shows us the direction of the…
Step into the masjid with your ___ foot first.
The water taps in the masjid are for making…
True or false? Pushing and shoving at the mosque door is good manners.

think.q: Next time you go to the masjid, which du'aa will you say at the door, and with which foot?
think.a: Right foot in: Allāhumma ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik!

parents.summary: The masjid: qiblah, mihrab, minbar, wudu taps; right foot in and left foot out with the du'aas; tasbih 33 times after prayer.
parents.tip: Take him to the masjid this week and point out the mihrab and minbar.
